description: This Java class defines an action to launch the Android DDMS (Dalvik Debug Monitor Server) tool within an IDE environment, managing process handling, command execution, and ADB service state.

classes.name: AndroidRunDdmsAction
classes.description: An action class to launch and manage the DDMS tool process within the IDE.

methods.name: AndroidRunDdmsAction
methods.description: Constructor initializing the action with a specific title.

methods.name: doRunTool
methods.description: Executes the process to launch DDMS, handling process state and ADB service checks.

methods.name: doLaunchDdms
methods.description: Handles the actual process creation, execution, and cleanup for DDMS.

methods.name: getDdmsProcessHandler
methods.description: Returns the current process handler for DDMS if active.

methods.name: getDdmsCmdName
methods.description: Determines the command path for the DDMS monitor based on system architecture and OS.
